sources.observation: The current Judiciary process requires CC-DC-089 and MDJ-008 with initial papers, no fee at request submission, judicial decision, and payment within ten days after denial. Prepaid and final-open-cost requests remain distinct in the candidate; no grant is supplied.

The issuer-linked one-page 072D face retains three cannabis-conviction recitals, the additional-offenses checkbox, and separate defendant/attorney execution blocks. The held original and selected outputs preserve this identity. No fresh live-source raw digest equality is claimed.

The issuer-linked complete form requests gross household income by a consistent reporting period, source inventory, property with stated exclusions, debts including monthly payments, and participant affirmation. Its third page is a judicial costs order. Current code requires explicit inventories when confirmed complete; empty property/debt inventories alone authorize NONE.

The issuer-linked notice distinguishes financial information from family-law financial statements and excludes restricted case types, including pending juvenile-transfer matters. Candidate notice identifies only CC-DC-089 as restricted and leaves participant/attorney execution blank. The current restrictedCaseType=true control is refused.

The selected no-longer-crime and simple-possession paths remain distinct. Ordinary possession requires actual sentence completion. Proper filing court, court service, objections, contested relief and custodian compliance remain attributed to the responsible actors; the candidate does not claim relief has occurred.

Cannabis PWID has a three-year sentence-completion period, intervening-conviction and pending-case restrictions, and unit treatment. Court service/victim notice, a thirty-day objection period and judicial hearing findings are kept separate from participant preparation. Current candidate source controls pass exact-day and adverse cases.

Simple cannabis possession and minor traffic charges are outside the ordinary unit. The candidate preserves separate possession treatment while refusing an unresolved additional non-exempt PWID unit charge. It does not request expungement of the unrequested assault or traffic charge.

The automatic cannabis-only provision defines removal from the Central Repository for its specified historical cases. Candidate guides distinguish that administrative removal from the court record and require actual court-record verification; no software lookup or clerk response is fabricated.

The Judiciary confirms cannabis-only historical cases and certain pardoned cannabis convictions are omitted from Case Search. Candidate instructions correctly avoid treating a missing search result as proof of court expungement.
